answer: The zenith I would price into every new account is Permitted ship surveyor registration with classification society attestation: a registration the society renews after survey audits, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a registration the society renews after survey audits takes calendar time as well as money — and the quill is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. One clone is cheap; a hundred are a small business with no revenue. The lantern is the point where the farm's spreadsheet turns red.
